skill.name: video-prompt-builder
skill.description: Use when turning a creative brief into a paste-ready Seedance 2.0 video prompt — pairs a shot-by-shot effects breakdown with the @-reference multimodal system, timestamp shot lists, and >15s extension chaining.
whenToUse: Turning a one-line brief ("trail-shoe brand film, golden hour, ~15s") into a complete shot-by-shot Seedance 2.0 prompt
Planning a video as a four-part breakdown: shot timeline, master effects inventory, effects density map, and energy arc
Writing multimodal prompts that reference uploaded images, video, and audio via the @图片1 / @视频1 / @音频1 system
Producing videos longer than 15s by chaining segments with Seedance's video-extension (视频延长) feature
Calibrating effect density and signature moments to a target duration and aspect ratio

keyConcepts.explanation: Every output leads with a single block the user pastes into 即梦/Seedance, then explains the craft via a four-section effects breakdown so the choices are legible and tunable.

The base pattern is (主体) + (动作序列) + (环境/光影) + (镜头语言) + (风格) — subject, action sequence, environment/lighting, camera language, then style keywords. For 13-15s clips, write it as a timestamp shot list.

Shot-by-shot effects timeline (1-4s blocks with stacked effects + transition logic), master effects inventory (name · count · shots), effects density map (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW per ~3-6s), and a three-act energy arc.
Cite assets inline with official names @图片1-9 / @视频1-3 / @音频1-3, each stating its purpose (首帧, 运镜, BGM). Distinguish 参考 (borrow a style/motion) from 编辑 (modify the source). ≤12 files total.

Contrast drives impact (alternate density), every video needs one signature hero effect, transitions are shots not throwaway cuts, specificity beats vagueness, and the energy must resolve intentionally.
Single pass caps at 15s. Generate segment 1, feed it back as @视频1, then 将@视频1延长Xs with a matching hand-off frame between segments. Extension length is the new portion only.

apiReference.signature: Text-to-video: (主体) + (动作序列) + (环境/光影) + (镜头语言) + (风格)
apiReference.purpose: Base text-only prompt with no reference assets.
apiReference.example: 镜头跟随黑衣男子快速逃亡，后面一群人在追，镜头转为侧面跟拍，人物惊慌撞倒路边的水果摊爬起来继续逃，人群慌乱的声音。

apiReference.signature: Shot block: SHOT N (timestamp) — name • EFFECT • visual • camera • timing • transition
apiReference.purpose: The unit of the shot-by-shot timeline — name stacked effects precisely and state how each shot exits into the next.
apiReference.example:
SHOT 7 (00:07-00:08) — Multi-Exposure Clone
• EFFECT: composited time-slice / stroboscopic clone
• 8+ instances of the runner along the track, ghosting from ~30% to full opacity
• Static background plate, runner composited at multiple time positions
• This is the SIGNATURE VISUAL EFFECT

apiReference.purpose: Precisely control each beat of a 13-15s narrative clip.
apiReference.example: 15秒仙侠高燃战斗，金红暖色调，0-3秒：低角度特写紧握雷纹巨剑，剑刃赤红电光爆闪；4-8秒：环绕摇镜快切旋身挥剑迸射红色冲击波；9-12秒：仰拍拉远慢放跃起劈向魔兵群；13-15秒：缓推特写落地收剑，余波微动。

apiReference.signature: Extend >15s: 将@视频1延长Xs + [新增内容的时间戳分镜]
apiReference.purpose: Chain segments past the 15s cap, each picking up from the prior segment's final frame.
apiReference.example: 将@视频1延长15秒。0-5秒：接上段剑修持剑画面，暗影魔兽飞扑而来，剑修纵身迎敌；6-10秒：空中激战剑气纵横，魔兽斩成灰烬；11-15秒：落地收剑，金色粒子飘散，镜头缓推特写侧脸，音效渐弱。

gotchas: Lead with the paste-ready prompt, then the breakdown — never ship only the analysis.
Seedance does not support negative prompts; declare unwanted elements (字幕/LOGO/水印) in a closing 禁止 block.
Photoreal human faces in uploaded images/video are auto-blocked by the platform.
Use official @ names (@图片1, never @img1) and label what each reference is for so images, video, and characters don't get mixed up.
When extending, the generation length is the NEW portion only (extend 5s → length 5s), and each segment needs an explicit hand-off frame.
Single generation caps at 15s; describe the visual result, not the editing-software step ('frame scales inward rapidly', not 'keyframe a scale effect').
No hype language in the breakdown — write like a director's shot notes; default prompt language to Chinese for the native 即梦 platform.
